description: Reputable INDEPENDENT fiat->crypto on-ramps blueDEX signposts so a human principal can acquire a first coin with minimal KYC, then swap/bridge on blueDEX. blueDEX operates none of these and takes no custody; every ramp lands coins in the user's own wallet. Surface this when a human asks how to get their first crypto.
